# DigiScience Techsol

> AI-first cloud transformation partner for secure, governed, industry-specific AI solutions on Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud.

DigiScience Techsol helps enterprise and mid-market teams assess AI readiness, choose practical first use cases, build secure cloud-hosted AI pilots, and add responsible AI governance before scaling. The company is based in New Delhi, India and serves global buyers in manufacturing, healthcare, legal, BFSI/insurance, logistics, HR/recruitment, retail, education, real estate, and public sector workflows.

## Core Offers

- AI Readiness Assessment: entry offer for scoring use cases, data readiness, cloud readiness, security posture, responsible AI risk, business value, and pilot feasibility.
- 45-Day Industry AI Pilot: controlled proof of value for one high-priority AI workflow with architecture, governance controls, working pilot, success metrics, and scale roadmap.
- Secure Enterprise AI Cloud Platform: secure AI landing zones with IAM/RBAC, private networking, audit logging, monitoring, data classification, AI service access, and cost governance.
- Responsible AI Governance and Agent Control: prompt security, model risk controls, human approval, hallucination risk management, audit trail, agent permissions, and compliance mapping.
- AI-Ready DevOps and Platform Engineering: DevSecOps, MLOps, LLMOps, release approval, observability, and production support patterns for AI systems.
- Cloud Modernization for AI Readiness: targeted modernization required to make cloud, data, security, and delivery foundations ready for governed AI adoption.

## Pricing Snapshot

- AI Readiness Assessment: INR 49K / USD 599 one-time.
- AI Pilot Starter: INR 75K / USD 899 per month, plus one-time setup from INR 2.5L / USD 3K.
- AI Pilot Growth: INR 1.5L / USD 1,799 per month, plus one-time setup from INR 5L / USD 6K.
- Governed AI Platform: INR 3L / USD 3,499 per month, plus one-time setup from INR 9L / USD 10K.
- Regulated AI Transformation: custom quote after discovery for regulated or complex needs.

Cloud usage, LLM tokens, paid third-party tools, and unusually complex integrations are quoted separately after discovery.

## Priority Industries

- Manufacturing AI: predictive maintenance, quality intelligence, plant operations support, downtime reduction, production planning, and operator decision support.
- Healthcare AI: administrative workflow automation, patient support workflows, clinical documentation support, governed knowledge retrieval, and compliance-aware deployment.
- Legal Document Intelligence: contract review, clause extraction, obligation tracking, legal knowledge assistants, source-grounded answers, and reviewer workflows.
- BFSI and Insurance AI: compliance intelligence, claims triage, risk review, document automation, audit evidence, and governed decision support.
- Logistics AI: shipment exception intelligence, route and capacity insights, customer update automation, and operations workflow support.
- HR and Recruitment AI: candidate screening support, policy assistants, onboarding knowledge assistants, and human-reviewed workflow automation.
- Retail AI: demand intelligence, product support, customer service augmentation, merchandising insights, and operational analytics.

## Recommended First Step

For a new buyer, start with the AI Readiness Assessment. It validates whether a business problem is suitable for AI, whether the data and cloud environment can support a pilot, which governance controls are required, what success metrics should be used, and whether a 45-day pilot is justified.
